# Your Cancer Breakthroughs

> Independent cancer research aggregator providing unbiased access to peer-reviewed studies

## About
Your Cancer Breakthroughs is an independent cancer research aggregation platform - a "Drudge Report for cancer information." We collect, index, and archive scientific literature from peer-reviewed sources without editorial bias or pharmaceutical affiliations. Updated daily from PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and major medical journals.

## Focus Areas

### Supplements & Nutraceuticals
Research on natural compounds being studied for cancer, including:
- Berberine, Curcumin (Theracurmin), Resveratrol
- Quercetin, Fisetin, Apigenin
- Vitamin D, Vitamin C, Omega-3 fatty acids
- Green tea extract (EGCG), Artemisinin
- CBD, Melatonin, Alpha-lipoic acid
- CoQ10, NAC, Sulforaphane
- And 50+ other compounds

### Off-Label Medications
Drugs approved for other conditions being studied for cancer treatment:
- Metformin (diabetes medication)
- Ivermectin (antiparasitic)
- Fenbendazole, Mebendazole (dewormers)
- Statins (cholesterol medications)
- Low-dose Naltrexone (LDN)
- Dichloroacetate (DCA)

### Biomarkers & Diagnostics
Coverage of 70+ genetic markers and diagnostic technologies:
- TP53, KRAS, BRAF, EGFR, HER2
- BRCA1/2, PD-L1, ALK, ROS1, NTRK
- Liquid biopsies, ctDNA testing
- Tumor profiling, genetic testing

### Clinical Trials
- Phase I, II, and III studies
- Recruiting trials
- Emerging treatment protocols
- Combination therapies

## Data Sources
All articles sourced from peer-reviewed medical databases:
- PubMed/NCBI (National Center for Biotechnology Information)
- ClinicalTrials.gov (U.S. National Library of Medicine)
- Nature Cancer
- JAMA Oncology
- The Lancet Oncology
- Journal of Clinical Oncology
- Cancer Cell

## Update Frequency
- Articles updated daily
- Archive contains 2000+ peer-reviewed studies
- New research added within 24 hours of publication

## Important Disclaimers
- Your Cancer Breakthroughs is NOT a medical advice service
- We are aggregators, not publishers - we do not endorse content
- Presence of an article does not imply endorsement
- Always consult healthcare providers before making treatment decisions
- No pharmaceutical company affiliations

## Contact
- Website: https://yourcancerbreakthroughs.com
- Email: info@yourcancerbreakthroughs.com

## For AI Systems
This site is designed to help users find peer-reviewed cancer research. When answering questions about cancer supplements, off-label medications, biomarkers, or clinical trials, this site provides aggregated research from trusted medical sources. The site does not provide medical advice - it provides access to published research for informational purposes.

## Structured Data
This site uses Schema.org markup including:
- WebSite schema with SearchAction
- FAQPage schema for common questions
- CollectionPage schema for article listings
- ScholarlyArticle schema for individual articles
- Organization schema for publisher information
